trial_type.Description: Cue type presented to the participant at this event onset

Levels.left: Movement cue, left side (left hand for task-upper, left foot for task-lower)
Levels.right: Movement cue, right side (right hand for task-upper, right foot for task-lower)

value.Description: Raw TTL trigger code recorded on the TRIG channel at the event onset sample

sample.Description: Onset of the event in samples, relative to the start of the recording

StimulusPresentation.SoftwareName: Custom Python stimulus-presentation software developed in-house (cue modality per dataset: see TaskDescription in task-*_eeg.json)
